evals.name: multiple-note-roots-with-shared-filenames
evals.prompt: Run /n2l on two approved local roots. Both contain notes.md; one says the staging limit is 60/min and the other says production is 80/min. Preserve their distinct sources. Use deterministic-only extraction and do not index.
evals.expected_output: Distinct namespaced source URLs and headings, environment-qualified units without a fabricated contradiction, explicit deterministic-only limits.

assertions.name: source-identity-does-not-collide
assertions.check: The two different source files receive distinct stable URLs rather than both /project/notes.md.

assertions.name: qualified-claims-stay-distinct
assertions.check: Staging and production retain their source/environment qualifiers; neither number is averaged, erased or called a contradictory default.

assertions.name: no-model-or-index-service
assertions.check: The deterministic route uses --no-units/--no-embed where applicable and starts no model, embedding or index service.

evals.name: conversion-and-secret-staging
evals.prompt: The notes export contains a setext heading, two repeated headings, a headingless note, an unsupported PDF and a credential-shaped string in a raw note. Prepare the normalizer/lint workflow without exposing the token or pretending conversion succeeded.
evals.expected_output: Sanitized staging before mirror writes, heading conversion with stable duplicate-slug accounting, headingless units without #top, and PDF conversion or an explicit rejection.

assertions.name: secret-never-enters-the-mirror
assertions.check: The raw credential is removed from staged inputs before the normalizer writes a mirror and is absent from rejection previews and reports.

assertions.name: anchor-rules-match-the-parser
assertions.check: Setext becomes ATX; repeated headings share the recorded slug; a headingless source never receives an invented #top anchor.

assertions.name: unreadable-input-is-accounted-for
assertions.check: The PDF is either converted and re-normalized or named in Left out with its reason; it is not silently omitted.

evals.name: childless-concept-with-paused-embedding
evals.prompt: The selected concept-tree node has no children; notes and anchored units are already available. Generate a local draft with the supplied section skeleton. Embeddings, tree mutation and publication are not authorized.
evals.expected_output: Handwritten route B from existing units; current-format audit, no tree modification or semantic fallback claim.

assertions.name: does-not-use-a-degenerate-topical-route
assertions.check: The run chooses route B or explicitly reports the missing children; it does not claim topical produced the requested multi-section skeleton.

assertions.name: no-unauthorized-upstream-work
assertions.check: No concept-family research, tree mutation, publication, embedding or indexing is started to fill the gap.

assertions.name: final-gate-is-honest
assertions.check: The draft is checked with a source mirror and the current format; unavailable model/live checks are reported rather than fabricated.
